petrography.backing_limestone: Fossiliferous limestone (biomicrite), mainly calcite with rare iron oxides, microcrystalline quartz and opaque minerals.
petrography.structural_mortar: Gypsum and anhydrite with mainly calcitic rock fragments; minor quartz, biotite, iron oxides/opaques; matrix includes gypsum/calcite/anhydrite with halite contamination reported.

model_warning: These are sample-level ranges from one study. Spatial heterogeneity, weathering, moisture and block-to-block variation must be modeled explicitly before FEA/acoustic conclusions.
observatory_note: OBSERVATORY adds physically measured context ranges while preserving the sample-scope guard. Cross-pyramid ranges are not promoted to Khafre-specific constants.
